memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Marcus identified a Monday-evening ORD-PHX outbound and retained two Wednesday return candidates pending a hotel decision and confirmation of whether the final meeting ends at 4:00 or 6:00 p.m.

messages.content: I need to be in suburban Phoenix for an opening review Tuesday and Wednesday, January 13 and 14. The first walkthrough is at 9:00 Tuesday, so I should fly from Chicago Monday evening.
Which suburb is the site in, and what time can you leave Chicago Monday? Also, is the Wednesday finish firm enough to choose a return now?

The restaurant is in Chandler near Loop 202 and Arizona Avenue. I can leave for ORD around 3:30 Monday. Wednesday is supposed to end at 4:00, but the local team may add a meeting that runs until 6:00.

With a 3:30 departure for ORD, I would look at nonstop flights leaving after 5:30 p.m. Monday. For Tuesday, staying in Chandler Monday night is the dependable choice; a PHX-area hotel would add an avoidable morning drive. I’ll compare the outbound first, then returns that work for both Wednesday scenarios. Are you traveling with a carry-on only?
Yes, carry-on only. Keep this in economy. I don’t need the absolute cheapest fare if the schedule is better.

The strongest Monday option is American, ORD 6:05 p.m. to PHX 8:58 p.m., nonstop. Allowing roughly 25 minutes to exit the airport and 30 to 40 minutes by rideshare to Chandler, you should reach a hotel around 10:00 p.m. A United nonstop at 7:35 p.m. arrives at 10:28 p.m., putting you in Chandler close to midnight. The earlier American flight gives you much more margin before the 9:00 a.m. walkthrough.
Carry the 6:05 American flight forward. What are the Wednesday choices? I don’t want to book something that only works if everyone ends exactly on time.

For a 4:00 p.m. finish, an American nonstop leaving PHX at 7:20 p.m. and reaching ORD at 11:40 p.m. is workable. From Chandler, I would leave by 4:30 and allow 45 to 60 minutes to PHX in rush-hour traffic, giving you about two hours at the airport. It is not viable if the meeting runs to 6:00. The safer option is United at 9:35 p.m., arriving ORD at 1:44 a.m. Thursday. Even after a 6:00 finish, leaving by 6:20 should put you at PHX around 7:15 to 7:30.
Is there anything between those two? The 1:44 arrival is rough.

There is a Southwest nonstop at 8:15 p.m., arriving MDW at 12:20 a.m. It works if you finish at 4:00, but after a 6:00 meeting the margin is thin: a 6:10 departure from Chandler could reach MDW-bound check-in and security at PHX around 7:05 to 7:20. With only a carry-on it is possible, though a traffic delay would make it uncomfortable. It also returns to Midway rather than O’Hare.
Drop that one. Compare the cost of the American outbound paired with the 7:20 American return versus the same outbound and the 9:35 United return.

The all-American round trip is $418 in standard economy. The split ticket is $463 total: $226 for American Monday and $237 for United Wednesday. Both include a carry-on and advance seat selection, but separate tickets mean separate confirmations and change handling. The $45 difference buys protection against the possible late meeting.
Don’t book yet. Hold those two return candidates while we work out the hotel and whether the local team can confirm Wednesday.

Understood. The working outbound is American on Monday, January 12, ORD 6:05 p.m. to PHX 8:58 p.m. The Wednesday candidates are American at 7:20 p.m., suitable for the planned 4:00 finish, and United at 9:35 p.m., suitable if the meeting runs until 6:00. For the hotel search, I’ll center on Chandler near Loop 202 and Arizona Avenue so Tuesday’s 9:00 a.m. start is dependable. No flight has been booked.
